mapper.select: SELECT r.route_id, r.departure_airport_id, ad.iata_code || ' (' || ad.airport_name || ')' AS dep_airport_name, r.arrival_airport_id, aa.iata_code || ' (' || aa.airport_name || ')' AS arr_airport_name, r.flight_type, r.route_type_id, rt.type_name AS type_name, r.is_active FROM ROUTE r JOIN AIRPORT ad ON r.departure_airport_id = ad.airport_id JOIN AIRPORT aa ON r.arrival_airport_id = aa.airport_id LEFT JOIN ROUTE_TYPE rt ON r.route_type_id = rt.route_type_id ORDER BY r.route_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTE ( departure_airport_id, arrival_airport_id, flight_type, route_type_id, is_active ) VALUES ( #{departure_airport_id}, #{arrival_airport_id}, #{flight_type}, #{route_type_id}, 'Y' )
